tasks.title: Announcement #43
tasks.instruction: Listen to a campus radio announcement.
tasks.transcript: Woman: The due date for submitting photographs to the Campus Photography Contest is today at 3:00 PM. If you would like to enter but have not yet submitted a photograph, remember to do so today. After all submissions are in, selected photography students will judge the photos and declare a winner. The winner's name and winning photo will be printed in the campus newspaper, and all photographs entered will be posted on the university website next Wednesday.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?

options.B: To say who won a contest
options.C: To tell when an exhibit will end
options.D: To remind students of a deadline

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 这个通知的目的是什么？ 定位原文: "The due date for submitting photographs to the Campus Photography Contest is today at 3:00 PM. If you would like to enter but have not yet submitted a photograph, remember to do so today." 选项分析: A. To ask for volunteer judges (为了招募志愿者评委) - 错误。文中提到评委是 "selected photography students"（被选出的摄影系学生），并没有公开招募。 B. To say who won a contest (为了宣布谁赢了比赛) - 错误。比赛还没结束，获胜者将在之后公布。 C. To tell when an exhibit will end (为了告知展览何时结束) - 错误。文中未提及展览结束时间。 D. To remind students of a deadline (为了提醒学生截止日期) - 正确。通知的核心就是提醒大家今天下午 3 点是提交作品的截止时间。

questions.stem: Where will students be able to view all the photographs?
questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 学生可以在哪里看到所有的摄影作品？ 定位原文: "...all photographs entered will be posted on the university website next Wednesday." 选项分析: A. On a Web site (在一个网站上) - 正确。文中明确提到 "university website"。 B. At a local museum (在当地博物馆) - 错误。文中未提及。 C. In the campus newspaper (在校报上) - 错误。校报只会刊登 "The winner's name and winning photo"（获胜者名字和获胜作品），而不是所有作品。 D. In a campus building (在校园建筑里) - 错误。文中未提及实体展览。
